title: [DEV] AAPSClient misses to download insulin cartridge change
symptom: There was an insulin cartridge change, which got uploaded to NS. Probably AAPSClient device was not online that time. In AAPSClient insulin amount is in sync, but the insulin cartridge change won't update.
fix: MilosKozak suggests trying full sync to see if the event gets received, and later references a commit that likely fixes the issue.
evidence_quote: it's not possible to find the reason from this info. you may try full sync if the event get received
